deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next scheduling housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference, re-anchored after the status-local-config-presence-warning cycle additively grew spec.md.
description: Doc-surface line counts of scheduling. The prior wave slimmed docs/spec.md to 871 lines; the FT-E loop-redesign reconciliation re-anchored it to 900; the self-healing known-port adapter-map migration re-anchored it to 936; the issue/PR-named dispatch-description cycle re-anchored spec.md to 944; the stale/incompatible tick-checkpoint discard-and-fresh cycle re-anchored spec.md to 983; the per_item dispatch-description-always-names-the-ref cycle re-anchored spec.md to 993; the advisory-REVIEW always_ok cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1008; the immediate-refire cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1069; the pool-based-refire + integrate/refire-observability cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1090; the §3.11.5 loopback opt-out PULL wiring cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1103; the file-referenced dispatch prompt cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1138; the remove-self-deploy-action cycle additively re-anchored spec.md to 1173; the remove-IMPLEMENT-harness-isolation cycle (a real behavior cycle, #335) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1181; the read-shipped-default-config-fresh cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick reads the shipped default-config/{route,adapter-map}.json FRESH else the embedded constant, and start.py's seed_default_config seed-once copy is retired, #337) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1195; the measured per-fix-rationale slim (#345) tightened redundant/restated rationale and decorative parenthetical prose WITHOUT dropping any load-bearing token, reducing spec.md to 1151; the wire-cumulative-GATE cycle (a real behavior cycle: pre-map the GATE port to run_tick:make_gate, delegate make_gate to verify_integrate.make_gate, and seed the gate_results read product when GATE is routed) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1157; the IMPLEMENT-template-task cycle (a real behavior cycle: the IMPLEMENT agent template carries a non-empty task + an opened output_example, and _build_agent_entry threads the template task onto dispatch['task']) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1169; the issue-filter-wiring cycle (a real behavior cycle: make_pull threads sg.issue_filter(runtime['governance']) into wi.Pull(issue_filter=...), mirroring the work_own_filings threading) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1183; the richer-status cycle (a real behavior cycle: status.py exposes a machine-first status_data() + a derived render_status(data) human view emphasizing the plugin version and listing the active route's states + happy-path chain, resolved via a shared run_tick helper) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1209; the tick-single-tick + start-owns-drain-loop cycle (a real behavior cycle, §3.3.3: /auto-maintainer:tick runs EXACTLY ONE tick and STOPS — refire is reported but not auto-looped — and /auto-maintainer:start OWNS the drain-loop, firing /tick again on refire until non-refire for tick #1 and each heartbeat; SKILL-prose only, run_tick/--step/--resume unchanged) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1232; the tick_end-identifiers + /clobber-reset cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick's tick_end.detail gains additive per-issue/per-PR identifier lists handoffs_detail/integrated/reported_detail sourced from read products already in scope, and a new src/clobber.py + /auto-maintainer:clobber skill reset the loop's runtime state while preserving config) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1269 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the clobber /stop-advice-keyed-on-loop-intent cycle (a real behavior cycle: clobber.py surfaces a deterministic loop_intent_present flag read from heartbeat's durable loop-intent marker BEFORE deletion, and the /clobber SKILL keys its /stop-first recommendation on that flag rather than on disposition) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1282 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the status-skill-verbatim-relay cycle (a real behavior cycle: the /auto-maintainer:status SKILL relays status.py's FULL rendered human view verbatim in a fenced code block, correcting the stale v0.1.0 'one status line' wording; SKILL-prose only, status.py unchanged) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1290 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the auto_merge_enabled-in-tick_end cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick surfaces integration_result.auto_merge_enabled as a PENDING-success count in the tick_end detail + one-line trace, distinct from integrate_errored) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1294 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the issue_filter-apply-labels REPORT-flush cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick's _flush_report resolves sg.issue_filter_apply_labels(gov) and threads it as wi.file_discoveries' apply_labels so project-target loop-filed discoveries carry the PULL-visibility labels) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1306 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the RECONCILE-state + reject-disposition-enactment cycle (a real behavior cycle, Wave-2 consumers: run_tick adds make_reconcile wrapping verify_integrate.Reconcile before PULL — seeding its acted_ledger slot from the durable ACTED_LEDGER_KEY opened entries and persisting reconcile_result.closed_issues/relanded back into the ledger — and enacts reject dispositions at the TRIAGE resume via wi.reject_dispositions + wi.gh_issue_reject_sink + a triage_memory rejected status) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1345 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the clobber-preview-UX cycle (a real behavior cycle: clobber.py replaces the user-facing --yes flag with an internal --apply flag, defaults to a machine-first PREVIEW payload {mode,artifacts,preserved,loop_intent_present} that deletes nothing, and the /auto-maintainer:clobber SKILL renders WOULD-DELETE/PRESERVED tables + gates on a verbatim 'yes' before applying, with --no-dry-run as the no-gate immediate-delete path) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1372 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the per-dispatch-reemit-preserve-validated cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick's invalid_output / crash-safety re-emit is PER-DISPATCH — it re-dispatches ONLY the not-yet-valid dispatches and PRESERVES a dispatch whose output_path already holds a schema-valid output, stopping the duplicate-PR root cause; and the tick_end detail + one-line trace surface the RECONCILE deduped count) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1403 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the status-shows-heartbeat-interval cycle (a real behavior cycle: status.py's status_data() gains a heartbeat_interval_minutes field read from the SAME sg.load_config heartbeat.interval_minutes start.py reads, and render_status prints a `heartbeat <n> min` line; read-only, --line stays byte-identical) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1408 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the RECONCILE prior_verdicts race-breaker cycle (a real behavior cycle: make_reconcile also seeds Reconcile's OPTIONAL prior_verdicts ctx slot from the durable persisted verdicts read-product, verbatim, seeding [] when absent; _seed_context registers+seeds it alongside acted_ledger when RECONCILE is routed and prior_verdicts is added to _INITIAL_SLOTS) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1420 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the RECONCILE auto_merged-completion observability cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick consumes verify-integrate's reconcile_result.auto_merged to surface auto_merged=<n> + auto_merged_refs in the tick_end detail and a >0-only auto_merged=<n> trace token, and _persist_reconcile_outcome stamps each auto_merged acted_ledger entry to a TERMINAL outcome='merged' so _reconcile_ledger_seed never re-seeds it — report-once) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1435 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the RECONCILE canonical-pr_ref + prior_verdicts-durable-snapshot cycle (a real behavior cycle: _reconcile_ledger_seed seeds pr_ref in the canonical owner/repo#N form derived from the acted-ledger's stored PR URL — fixing verify-integrate's tier-1 int(<url>) crash and aligning the prior_by_ref key form — and make_reconcile seeds prior_verdicts from a NEW durable PRIOR_VERDICTS_KEY snapshot written at tick end and EXEMPT from _reset_ephemeral_read_products, instead of the ephemeral verdicts read product the fresh-tick reset wipes before RECONCILE runs, so the race-breaker finally has data) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1450 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the RECONCILE recovery-outcome observability cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick's tick_end detail + one-line trace surface reconcile_result's rebased/relanded/reconcile_errors counts + rebased_refs/relanded_refs, derived EXACTLY like deduped/auto_merged with >0-only trace tokens, closing the gap where a silently-erroring RECONCILE was invisible) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1462 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the RECONCILE seed -wo-suffix issue_ref fix cycle (a real behavior cycle: _reconcile_ledger_seed derives the canonical owner/repo#N issue_ref by stripping the wo- prefix OR the -wo suffix — the live producer's form — else the id as-is, fixing the malformed owner/repo#N-wo that broke `gh issue view N-wo` in RECONCILE's merged-PR issue-close) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1471 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the in-flight-exclusion + already_done terminal-resolved-skip cycle (a real behavior cycle: make_pull computes an in-flight issue-ref set via _in_flight_issue_refs(state_path, pr_state_source) from the acted-ledger opened entries live-confirmed OPEN and threads it into wi.Pull(in_flight_issue_refs=...), and run_tick records an IMPLEMENT already_done handoff terminally in triage_memory — skip-unchanged status set gains already_done — WITHOUT incrementing backoff or the acted-ledger) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1532 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the already_done on-issue-enactment + strong-reason-guard cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick enacts the already_done disposition via work_intake.gh_issue_already_done_sink — reason composed from artifact.ref, trust-gated by permits('file', mode), issue left OPEN, injectable DEFAULT_ALREADY_DONE_SINK seam — and applies work_intake.is_strong_reason as a guard before enacting AND recording the terminal triage_memory status on BOTH the already_done and the reject dispositions) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1566 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the tick version+file provenance + status release-check cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick enriches the tick_start event detail with a machine-first version+file provenance block — plugin_version, lib_dir, runtime_dir, and the resolved config/route/adapter-map paths+sources — plus a compact plugin_version=<v> one-line-trace token, and status.py gains an injectable tolerant release probe DEFAULT_RELEASE_PROBE surfacing latest_version/update_available/release_check_error with a render_status update-available/up-to-date/errored line) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1609 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the status-local-config-presence-warning cycle (a real behavior cycle: status.py resolves config_path=<runtime_dir>/config.json and computes local_config_present — True ONLY when the file exists AND parses to a non-empty dict, absent/empty{}/invalid -> False, never crashing — exposes both on status_data(), and render_status shows a loud ASCII warning naming config_path + the shipped-defaults/auto-merge trap when absent else a quiet 'config <path>' confirmation; --line unchanged, no SKILL.md change) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1628 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate); the config-is-the-bound operator-in-control guidance cycle (a real behavior cycle: the /auto-maintainer:start and /auto-maintainer:tick shipped SKILL.md bodies embed guidance that the loop's limits are operator-owned + runner-enforced — the executor invents no ad-hoc token/tick/issue caps, keeps draining on refire absent a configured limit, meters subagent_tokens into the configured budget window only, and surfaces anomalies to the operator who bounds via /auto-maintainer:configure or halts via /auto-maintainer:stop) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1668 (contract.md keeps its baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate). The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are NOT larger than these re-anchored baselines and that the load-bearing tokens survived. The historical pre-wave spec baseline (commit 7a42f9c) was 871; FT-E was 900.
